text: First look: a cute floating island at night, a bunny-like creature, a tomato garden bed highlighted with a yellow box. Hint says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Top-left says Day 2 already, 26/30 sec. I have 10 coins, Lv1 0/90. Going to tap the crop.

Harvested: coins 10->14, XP 3. Day turned to day 3 (morning!). Then I tapped the farm but the bunny 'Momo' was standing on it, so I selected Momo instead (Free time / Assign panel). Will tap the empty part of the plot instead.
Sow -> water worked, crop is growing (Harvest 2s left). Day cycle is very quick, it's night again. Now it asks 'Tap a Momo' - the bunny. Tapping it.

Assigned Momo to the farm tile (1/4 tiles). Momo now 'Working at Farm'. Popup explains empty tiles can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab. A yellow box is around an empty grass tile on the left - probably suggesting I build there. Tapping Got it.
Momo farms by itself now - 9 jobs, coins rising to 26, +16/min. Nice idle feel. Mailbox has a red dot and Momo has an envelope bubble. Opening Mailbox.
A cute letter from Momo: 'What if we widened the field?' - a Field expansion research proposal. Love that the worker writes to me. Tapping Let's research it.
Research tree with tabs Farm/Lumber/Mine/Smelting/Power/Games... Field expansion costs 3 flasks + 20 coins, 20s. I have no flasks, there's a 'Build a research lab' button. Coins at 50. Trying it.

Build menu popped up: Farm 10, Mine opens Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special 0/1. So the lab needs level 2 first (I'm 60/90 XP). Not sure which tile it will go on - 'Free land' at the bottom. I'll build a second farm for 10 coins.

Second farm built, harvested it. Reached Level 2! 76 coins. A sea tile outlined with 5 appeared (expansion). Lab should be unlocked now - tapping the empty grass tile on the left to build a research lab.
Building the research lab for 40 coins (56 left). It says 'Research lab 0/1' - I guess it needs a worker. I only have one Momo, so I'll look at Hire.

Lab built. Tapping it shows an 'Experiment' button - I can make flasks by hand (flask counter shows 1 under the Day). The sea's '5' price label sits on top of the Experiment button, a bit cluttered. Hire costs 100, I have 76. Tapping Experiment.
112 coins - hiring a second Momo for 100 so it can staff the lab. 2 flasks so far.
Tried to tap the lab tile in pencil mode but it seems to have left the edit mode - Mochi still 'Free time'. Hmm. Trying the 'Assign' button instead.
'Another Momo works here' - so the lab is taken (the first Momo seems to be over at the lab now?). Bit confusing who is where. I'll put Mochi on the right-hand farm instead.

Got it: Assign then tap a building. Mochi now works the right farm. The Assign/Release buttons keep shifting position between panel states, which made me mis-tap once. 7 flasks, 80 coins - going to Research to buy Field expansion.
Field expansion researching (20s). Other farm techs show flask costs but are locked. Mailbox has a new red dot - checking it.
Field expansion done (Crops +1)! Second letter proposes Watering efficiency - accepting it. The letters seem to be how research gets unlocked.
Income jumped to ~148/min. Letters unlocked Watering efficiency and Bigger harvests in the tree. 10 flasks, 224 coins. Picking Bigger harvests (8 flasks).

'Next: City' opens a Status screen with a clear checklist to grow from Village to City: Land 4/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value 72/.5K. Now I have a goal! Plan: buy sea tiles (5), hire a third Momo.
Bought the sea tile - island grew, next one costs 85. Satisfying to watch the island grow. Now hiring a third Momo for the City checklist.
Hired Pomu (160). City checklist went to 1/4. Now I'll build a Mine on the empty grass so Pomu has a job and I try something new.
Mine needs 120 + Wood 10 (shown in red), so wood comes first. Building a Lumberyard for 80 - nice, the requirement chain reads clearly from the red text.
Lumberyard up and a Momo started chopping on its own (1/1), wood counter appeared top-left (2). Heart bubble over a Momo - cute. 13 flasks banked, spending them in Research.
Bigger harvests done, Watering efficiency researching (1m30s). Greenhouse and Seed selection unlocked next. Income ~208/min. Now buying the next land tile (85) for the City land goal.
Second land bought, island is now an L-shape snaking out. New letter in mailbox, opening it.
Mochi now writes too - proposes Tree nursery. Accepting. Wood at 8, almost enough for a mine. Coins 414, ~266/min.
Mine is building on the new land (120 coins + 10 wood). I'd like to see what it digs up, and a 4th Momo would be needed to staff it. Waiting for it to finish.
Mine done, cute little cave with a cart; shows Mine 1/1 and a Dig button. Tapping Dig to try it before time runs out.
